name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing but through the complex world of logistics. After graduating with a degree in Industrial Engineering from the Vienna University of Technology, she landed a role at a major automotive manufacturer, optimizing their supply chain. Dissatisfied with the corporate world, she made a lateral move into motorsport, initially managing the logistics for a small rally team. This hands-on experience exposed her to the operational intricacies of racing. 

Her meticulous approach and relentless drive quickly impressed the team owner, who encouraged her to pursue a more strategic role. She then moved to Full Time Sports. As Head of Operations, Klara is known for her data-driven decision-making and her ability to identify bottlenecks before they become problems. She's a firm believer in continuous improvement and isn't afraid to challenge the status quo, earning her respect and loyalty within the team, even if her methods are sometimes viewed as demanding.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Klara has a sharp, focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using a whiteboard for all team meetings, regardless of the number of attendees.
Has a collection of miniature F1 cars on her desk, each representing a race where the team overcame a significant challenge.
Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas or observations at any given moment.
